summary: You can now get the version of a vulnerable dependency directly from Dependabot alert responses in the REST API. Each alert’s dependency object includes a new version_requirement field with the version or version constraint that Dependabot last recorded for the alert.
takeaways: Dependency submission API: The resolved version submitted by your build tooling.

If you sync alerts to other security tools, you no longer need to parse lockfiles or make a separate GraphQL request for vulnerableRequirements to get that version.
